## Fixed

- **Dates you say come out as dates.** "Ship it on eleven twenty-nine" now pastes as "on 11/29". It only happens right after "on" and only for a real date, so a time like "by three thirty" keeps its words.
- **Repeated numbers are kept.** "On eleven eleven" no longer loses one "eleven" as if it were a stutter.
